scope: Vercel AI SDK integration behind existing provider ports with full tool compatibility routing, reported usage persistence, timeout/throttling/interrupted-stream handling, public DTO preservation, automatic coordinator lease release, and retry without user message duplication

acceptanceCriteriaVerified.details: Client cancellation mid-stream through real coordinator (coordinateTurn) triggers abort, marks message cancelled, logs aborted model call, and automatically releases single-writer turn lease in coordinator finally block without manual release; verified subsequent lease acquisition succeeds.

acceptanceCriteriaVerified.criterion: Controlled Failure Modes (Timeout, Throttling, Interrupted Stream)
acceptanceCriteriaVerified.details: Timeout mapped to 504 INFERENCE_TIMEOUT; rate limits (429/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED) mapped to 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; socket/stream disconnects mapped to 502 STREAM_INTERRUPTED.

Client-controlled adapter parameter removed from coordinateTurn req.body; public DTO preserved exactly ({ prompt, modelId, clientTurnId, retryOf }); adapter resolved strictly via server environment (SIRONA_PROVIDER_ADAPTER).

acceptanceCriteriaVerified.criterion: Turn Retry (retryOf) Reuses User Message Without Duplication
acceptanceCriteriaVerified.details: Retrying a failed/cancelled turn using retryOf reuses the original user message (COUNT(role='user') remains exactly 1), completes streaming turn, records model_calls, and automatically releases lease.

canHandle returns false for tool requests; AIService routes tool requests or tool message history to native Google GenAI adapter; AiSdkAdapter fails closed with 400 UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST if invoked directly with tools.
Derived actualPromptTokens and actualCompletionTokens from SDK streamResult.usage; updated user message tokens in PostgreSQL and persisted in model_calls.

verdict: PASS (P4 acceptance criteria completely verified with transcripts, source hashes, and zero regressions)
